format: single PLANET FITNESS facility (approx. 15,000 to 25,000 sq ft leased), equipment financed

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a single PLANET FITNESS® facility ranges from $1,282,500 to $3,769,000 if you finance your equipment.  This includes $33,300 to $353,500 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate.

fee.quote: Except as discussed below, you will pay a lump-sum nonrefundable Initial Franchise Fee of $40,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Initial Franchise Fees are currently waived for Franchise Agreements issued under Area Development Agreements (Area Development Fee $10,000 per location, or $30,000 in a previously terminated territory). Item 7 shows $0 - $40,000. Fitness equipment must be bought from affiliate PF Equipment ($333,000 to $995,000, or a down payment of $33,300 to $298,500 if financed).

royalty.basis: total gross monthly and annual membership fees payable via EFT (EFT Dues Draft)
royalty.quote: Royalty (See Note 2) 7% of the total gross monthly and annual membership fees payable to you via EFT Dues Draft (as described in Note 2). Paid monthly and annually.

adFund.quote: National Advertising Fund ("NAF") Fee 2% of monthly membership fees and certain annual membership fees, not to exceed 3% of the EFT Dues Draft. During 2026 only, 2% of the EFT Dues Draft, plus 1% of total gross monthly membership fees payable to you via EFT ("Monthly EFT")
adFund.note: NAF 2%, up to 3%; during 2026 only 2% plus 1% of Monthly EFT. Local Advertising Funds: greater of $60,000 or 7% of cumulative Monthly EFT in a year (during 2026 only, greater of $50,000 or 6%). Pre-sale/grand opening marketing up to $120,000.

otherRecurring.name: Join Fee
otherRecurring.amount: 20% of the regular monthly membership fee or 5% of the total price of a prepaid membership. Paid monthly; charged once per new membership

otherRecurring.name: Local Advertising Funds (minimum local spend)
otherRecurring.amount: Greater of $60,000 or 7% of cumulative Monthly EFT in a year (during 2026 only, greater of $50,000 or 6% of cumulative Monthly EFT)

otherRecurring.name: Re-Equip Costs
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $333,000 to $995,000 every 5 to 9 years, payable to our affiliate

otherRecurring.name: Remodel Costs
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $250,000 to $1,200,000; substantial remodeling as frequently as every 12 years

transferFee.amount: $10,000, plus our reasonable out-of-pocket expenses, including external legal and administrative costs we incur in connection with the transfer, which will not exceed $10,000 per club transferred.

A 2025 Revenue and Operations Statement (EBITDAR, EBITDA) is given for 262 corporate-owned clubs, but the table itself is not in the extracted text.

special: Royalty and NAF are on membership dues drafted by EFT (not total gross sales), charged on amounts due regardless of collection. Fitness equipment must be purchased from affiliate PF Equipment ($333,000 to $995,000) and replaced every 5 to 9 years at the same estimated cost; remodel $250,000 to $1,200,000 as often as every 12 years. Join Fee to franchisor of 20% of the monthly fee per new membership. If equipment is purchased rather than financed, total investment is $2,385,000 to $5,386,000 including $333,000 to $1,050,000 paid to the franchisor or its affiliate.
issues: No all-franchised-club average EFT revenue is printed (only thirds); headline uses the middle third. The corporate Revenue and Operations Statement table (EBITDAR/EBITDA, margins) is an image not present in the text, so no profit figures recorded. Item 7 table total spans $1,282,500 - $5,386,000 (financed low to purchased high); financed-equipment cover range used.
